name: Witch Doctor: Fool's Play clone fights with the target's own combat stats (#4103)
contract: Fool's Play 681007 summons a copy of an enemy that attacks it. The clone must copy its target's weapon
damage and deal more than the one-to-two-damage placeholder. Onyxian Whelp 11262 has an actual level-80
creature_template level band; setting a level-11 Harvest Golem fixture to level 80 only changes its level
field, leaving its original weapon base stats. Both the Witch Doctor and the target are level 80 so an
unintended twenty-level attack-skill penalty cannot determine the verdict. Independent target weapon
metadata is compared with the owned clone, then normal native melee damage must exceed 24 in twelve
seconds. Unit::CalculateDamage uses the calculated weapon update fields for ordinary physical swings;
the former contract incorrectly asserted that these swings always read the raw m_weaponDamage array.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The target template supplies actual level-80 weapon stats
Summon the Fool's Play clone of enemy0
Fool's Play copies the target's calculated minimum weapon damage
Let the clone close in and land several swings
SETUP: the clone is actually landing melee hits
Actual clone attacks exceed the 24-damage ceiling of twelve 1-to-2-damage swings
